description: Team FARMONAUTS, (2025 NASA Space Apps Global Nominees), tackles "Field Shift." Our tool, KRISHI (Knowledge-based Rotation Insights for Soil, Harvest & Irrigation), is a mobile-friendly, English + Bangla-supported tool that uses NASA Earth observation data and local soil information to recommend climate-resilient crop rotations that improve soil health and save water for Bangladeshi farmers and extension workers.
